issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: anvil, smithing_table, blast_furnace, cauldron, iron_bars.

visual.summary: The working smithy: anvil, forge and grindstone in the open bay, smoke on the chimney, a lantern and sign. Reads as a smithy at a glance.
problems: Reachability (flood fill from the ground outside): every floor and room is reached; only roof slopes and the tops of furniture are not, which is right
From outside L2 differs from L1 only by the smoke, grindstone and lantern; fine, but a quench barrel or ore pile by the door would make the step clearer
